chapters.about: Forced labor and physical barriers to Misvot

summary: Rabbi Hanon discusses the historical accounts of the Asara Harugei Malchut, specifically focusing on the martyrdom of Rabbi Chananya ben Teradion and Rabbi Akiva. He then explores Halakhic questions from the Holocaust era, as recorded by Rabbi Efraim Oshry in his book Mimamakim, regarding the preservation of Misvot under extreme duress.
questions: How did the great Rabbis maintain their faith while facing martyrdom?
Is it permissible to shave one's beard with a razor if it is a matter of life and death?
How does one fulfill the Misva of Tfillin when forced into labor before dawn?
What is the significance of the letters of the Torah flying to heaven during the burning of a Sefer Torah?
